taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.leaf_division.note: FEIS's broadleaf lupine review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-16): "The leaves are palmately compound".

traits.division_order.note: FEIS's broadleaf lupine review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-16): "palmately compound", once divided.

traits.leaflets.note: FEIS's broadleaf lupine review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-16): "The leaves are palmately compound with 5 to 10 leaflets".

traits.height_typical_m.note: FEIS's broadleaf lupine review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-16): "Plant heights range from 1 to 4 feet (0.3-1.2 m)".

traits.woodiness.note: FEIS's broadleaf lupine review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-16): "a native perennial forb" from "a woody caudex".

traits.life_span.note: FEIS's broadleaf lupine review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-16): "Broadleaf lupine is a native perennial forb".

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: FEIS's broadleaf lupine review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-16): "The leaflets are elliptic to lance-shaped, 1 to 3 inches (2.5-7.6 cm) long".

traits.leaf_shape.note: FEIS's broadleaf lupine review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-16): "The leaflets are elliptic to lance-shaped".

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: FEIS's broadleaf lupine review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-16): "The inflorescence is a showy raceme from 4 to12 inches (10-30 cm) long".

traits.flower_colour.note: A model estimate (confidence high), FEIS (Reeves 2006) gives no colour; the model's blue.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: FEIS's broadleaf lupine review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-16): "The fruit is a legume that is 0.8 to 1.8 inches (2-4.5 cm) long".

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: A model estimate (confidence high), FEIS (Reeves 2006) says only that the pods are "densely hairy"; the model's brown.

traits.flowering_months.note: FEIS's broadleaf lupine review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-16): anthesis in the "Pacific Northwest June to August".

generator.params.note: Bigleaf lupine's values, changed by hand for broadleaf lupine: a bushier clump of more stems from the woody caudex (FEIS, Reeves 2006: "a bushy, densely branched growth habit"), a little shorter, with shorter racemes. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 75 cm at 4 years in the open, the middle of FEIS's 0.3-1.2 m (Reeves 2006). Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Bigleaf lupine's look with a bluer flower, by eye.

traits.height_max_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium, record L2348178), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence medium, record L2348178), as no source read gives it.

traits.rosette.note: A model estimate (confidence medium, record L2348178), as no source read gives it.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: A model estimate (confidence medium, record L2348178), as no source read gives it.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium, record L2348178), as no source read gives it.
